title.narrative: Reconnaissance project in the Republic of Iraq

description.narrative: - Reviewing the current situation in health facilities in the Republic of Iraq to implement voluntary medical projects in the medical field targeting the most harmful groups of the Iraqi people.

Identifying hospitals in the city of Erbil and its neighboring cities in order to determine on the ground the possibility of implementing volunteer projects, and to know the need in terms of medical specialties, consumables, and medical equipment necessary to implement volunteer projects.

Sending a field medical team to evaluate several hospitals in the city of Erbil and neighboring cities in order to determine on the ground the possibility of implementing volunteer projects, and to know the need in terms of medical specialties, consumables, and medical equipment necessary to implement volunteer projects.
